resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.96.0 does not touch goal negotiation: goalMeta, the GOAL_* constants and src/goal-extension.ts are unchanged, and goals stay AIR-only upstream, so the patch is not absorbed. The v0.96.0 src/acp-agent.ts edits report each native subagent's model (#1432, #1434), send the current subagent states after a load response (#1423), stop holding an AIR load replay until the CLI starts (#1433), report SendMessage delegations as linked session messages (#1424) and run the subagent configuration hook for both subagent forms. None of them is in the lines this patch adds or removes. The adaptation only rebinds the patch identity; it changes no code. Protected alas history carries two copies of the v0.94 goal adaptation with identical added and removed lines: 3408f6ae41760b08cb9a2a96f5660d51c6295f82 (stable patch-id 14e887792182a3958f8403b76758143f0d6b1500, equal to the ledger commit 79047b35a8d185d78567d3c6875d1adfb986c8b7) and 22067f19cc8c3adc4367f023d534542fd69eaf78 (patch-id eb660c29f25f5893fb2199b4604b5c4fd7a9f8b5). They differ only in a context line that v0.95.0 added to the AIR capability list (#1262, `...(this.v2 ? [] : [AIR_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS_CAPABILITY])`). The candidate replays 22067f19cc8c3adc4367f023d534542fd69eaf78 first, cleanly and with an unchanged patch-id on v0.96.0. git cherry then does not recognise 3408f6a as applied, and its replay conflicts against the patch it already holds. Recording 22067f19cc8c3adc4367f023d534542fd69eaf78 as the patch commit retires 79047b35 and, through its patch-id, every copy of 3408f6a. Every older copy (patch-ids 3241135e, 7e9fc1c0, 421a3ffe) is already retired, and the replacement patch-id differs from all of them. The integration ships the same goal opt-in lines as 0.95.0-alas.1.
